competition.flat_book_pnl: A flat seat has zero net financing/competition P&L: paper NAV earning SOFR is benchmarked at SOFR, so those flows cancel, and shocked-risk financing is zero.
competition.funding_basis: Official NY Fed SOFR ACT/360 is the zero-return competition benchmark, not free alpha. Every seat has $100m paper NAV that may be described as earning SOFR, but that capital is equally funded/benchmarked at SOFR so those flows cancel. Deployed shocked-risk capital pays the same official SOFR on trusted standard-shock risk capital: the absolute MTM loss from a 1% adverse spot move, a 100bp (1 percentage point) adverse outright rate move, or a 100bp adverse curve/RV spread move under the trusted duration-1 P&L convention. Equal risk capital receives equal financing treatment across asset classes. Notional is descriptive, not the funding base. A completely flat book — including no-trade-skeptic — therefore has zero net financing/competition P&L from SOFR cash or funding economics. Positive financing/carry alpha requires an explicit markable strategy that earns above SOFR or funds below SOFR. Weekends and holidays carry the last applicable published fixing until the next fixing. If official fixing history cannot be established, new funding accrual fails closed and prior canonical balances are preserved.
competition.instruction: Do not optimize for gross notional or fill available capacity. Size risk from plausible adverse paths and historical excursions while staying inside the trusted risk-capital and drawdown limits. Flat cash at SOFR is the zero benchmark, not a source of alpha. The no-trade-skeptic must include a structured funding_view on every new risk or NO_TRADE thesis: the frozen official SOFR fixing, the relevant SR3 forward-curve view, its own assessment of whether realized funding will print higher, lower, or about the same as the curve, and the implication for remaining at the zero SOFR benchmark versus paying SOFR on shocked-risk capital.
competition.objective: Finish with the highest cumulative net paper P&L across the 14 standing seats.

news.headline: Global Oil Supply Buffer Running ‘Scarily Thin,’ Aramco CEO Says
news.summary: The oil stockpiles that cushion the world from supply shocks have become “scarily thin,” putting markets at risk of worsening unless the Strait of Hormuz reopens, according to the head of Saudi Arabia’s Aramco.

news.headline: Iran’s Oil Minister Resigns as Exports Dry Up Under US Pressure
news.summary: Iran’s Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned citing personal reasons, as the Islamic Republic tries to sustain its oil industry under a tightening US blockade.

news.headline: LNG Trade Through Hormuz Extends Rebound Despite Shipping Risks
news.summary: Shipments of liquefied natural gas through the Strait of Hormuz extended a rebound that began in September, as the region’s producers seek to restore supplies to energy-starved customers.

news.headline: China Oil Comeback Loses Steam as Iran War Drags On
news.summary: A nascent recovery in Chinese oil demand has begun to falter, as continued fighting in the Middle East and limited Iranian supply keep crude prices too high for private refiners.

news.headline: Euro-Zone Inflation Tops Estimates to Hit Three-Year High
news.summary: Euro-area inflation quickened more than expected to the highest in three years, bolstering expectations that the European Central Bank will lift interest rates further.

news.headline: Europe’s Bond-Spread Blowout Prompts Bets on Fewer ECB Hikes
news.summary: A surge in euro-area sovereign bond spreads slowed as traders bet the European Central Bank will deliver fewer interest-rate hikes to support more-indebted members.

news.headline: ECB Hopeful Knot Says Market Access At Risk If Nations Cut Rules
news.summary: Europe may have to reconsider the market access it gives other jurisdictions that are rapidly relaxing their financial regulations, ECB presidency candidate Klaas Knot said.

news.headline: Yen Strengthens Past 157 Per Dollar, Outperforming G-10 Peers
news.summary: The yen strengthened past the 157 level against the dollar as government warnings on the currency and quarter-end flows provided support.

news.headline: Shell’s LNG Canada to Proceed With Multibillion-Dollar Expansion
news.summary: Shareholders in the Shell-led LNG Canada venture made a final investment decision to expand liquefied natural gas exports on a multibillion-dollar plan.

news.headline: Man Group Says 5.5% Yields Risk Cracking AI Capex, US Consumer
news.summary: Man Group’s Kristina Hooper warned that surging long-end Treasury yields threaten AI capital expenditures and US consumer resilience.

news.headline: Pimco’s Stracke Says AI Spending Drove Yields, Not Inflation
news.summary: Surging capital demand from hyperscalers and the AI ecosystem—not inflation expectations—is the primary force pushing real rates and bond yields higher, Pimco’s Stracke said.

news.headline: UK Firms Predict Faster Price Increases After Energy Costs Surge
news.summary: The resurgence in oil and gas prices drove up UK businesses’ inflation expectations as firms planned to pass on cost increases to consumers.

causal.original_belief: The 2027 CORRA strip overpriced tightening versus a cash rate already at 2.30, so receiving the H-Z pack was the right easing expression.
causal.observed_reality: Rank moved from 2 to 8 with an interim drawdown near 89633 and net near -5787, then rank returned to 2 with positive net. Live H-Z near 3.264 remains below the 3.40 entry and far above cash 2.30.
causal.assumptions_right: Direction was right: the 2027 hike path was rich relative to cash, and the receive from 3.40 did not need to be abandoned.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Near-term mark-to-market and rank-path variance was underweighted; a correctly signed receive can still print a large interim drawdown and rank shock.
causal.causal_divergence: The shock was mark-to-market path, not a completed 2027 tightening cycle that validated December 2027 at 3.50. Cash stayed 2.30 in the supplied marks; the strip did not realize the priced hike path.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: The same information would still hold the receive and would still refuse an add on a rank 8-to-2 recovery.
causal.future_implication: Rank is not a sizing signal. Keep the existing 42.5 million receive and do not scale up because the shock reversed.
